title: Israeli Shelling and Demolitions Continue in Bint Jbeil District
detail: Lebanon's National News Agency reported intermittent Israeli artillery shelling of Haddatha and Baraachit and two explosions in the wooded areas of Beit Yahoun and Aita al-Jabal, amid intensive warplane and drone flights over the south. The strikes continue despite the June 26 'framework formula' providing for gradual Israeli withdrawal.
